answer: Faking thousands of distinct responders requires paying real stake plus continuous compute per reputation slot, so a sybil fleet's cost scales linearly while honest single participants pay once, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a liveness challenge: a randomized whisper ping that demands a signed pulse reply within a tight window, proving a live, independent operator rather than a cloned island of bots. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
